guide.summary: Customers connecting individual Todoist accounts fit the documented OAuth2 authorization code flow. The app must be registered with redirect URLs and client credentials, and the least-privilege documented grant covering read access to tasks is data:read. The GET /api/v1/tasks endpoint returns active tasks with cursor pagination (limit default 50, max 200). The data:read grant also covers projects, labels and filters, so the app's read-only behavior must come from the app's own code, not the grant. Provider review, marketplace or distribution requirements for other workspaces are not in the supplied snapshots and remain unknown.
